title: The Man with the Black Umbrella
status: complete; rebuild and content verification passed

planned.paragraphMeaning: The local police officer examines the school after the unexplained entry; the safe, money, inkstone, and phone remain untouched, and Mio notices her mother pause when asked whether anyone else has a key.
planned.sceneDescription: At night inside the Japanese calligraphy school, a local officer checks the undamaged door with a flashlight while Mio’s mother stands near an open small safe containing untouched belongings; Mio watches her mother’s brief hesitation.

planned.paragraphMeaning: At Tenmangū, Mio finds her grandfather’s wish on a votive tablet and realises he had been waiting for her to return to calligraphy; Sōta quietly gives her privacy.
planned.sceneDescription: Under a large tree in a Japanese shrine courtyard, Mio holds one plain unmarked wooden votive tablet and looks down with eyes beginning to shine; Sōta stands a short distance away, gently pretending to examine another blank tablet.

planned.paragraphMeaning: At the shrine gate, Mio recognises the black-umbrella man from the night before; he asks what her grandfather left, while she holds the votive tablet close.
planned.sceneDescription: On the shrine steps beneath a red torii, a tired, anonymous man pauses with a black umbrella tilted just enough to look toward Mio; Mio holds a plain tablet close and Sōta stays beside her, with the stranger’s identity unresolved.
